newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB Swiss sells unit to Concast.
newsitem.headline: ABB Swiss sells unit to Concast.

text.p: ABB Switzerland, part of electrical engineering group ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG, said it had signed an agreement to sell its business unit Electrical Arc Furnaces to Concast Standard AG.
The agreement covers development, production and sales worldwide of DC- and AC-arc furnaces as well as ladle furnaces for electrical steel melting, ABB said in a statement.
It added that ABB activities in India for AC arc furnaces are not included in the agreement.
ABB and Concast have also agreed on a long term cooperation so both companies can benefit from their knowledge of electrical steel melting.
ABB said it would continue to be a supplier of electrical equipment for electrical arc furnaces, particularly the rectifiers for the power supply of DC arc furnaces.
